t2.title: Celebrities be role models for young people
t2.prompt: You are participating in an online discussion forum. The topic is: "Should celebrities be role models for young people?" Write your response, giving reasons and examples. Write 180–200 words.
t2.sample:
The question of whether celebrities should be role models for young people is highly debated in today's society.

Many argue that celebrities should not be seen as role models. Their lives are often unrealistic, filled with luxury and privilege that ordinary people cannot achieve. Furthermore, some celebrities engage in irresponsible behavior, substance abuse, or promote unhealthy lifestyles that could negatively influence impressionable young fans.

However, others believe certain celebrities can be positive role models. Athletes like Marcus Rashford have used their platform to fight child poverty, while actors like Emma Watson advocate for gender equality. These celebrities inspire young people to care about social issues and make a difference.

In my opinion, celebrities should not automatically be considered role models. Instead, young people should look up to those who demonstrate genuine positive qualities, whether famous or not. Parents, teachers, and community leaders often make better role models than distant celebrities.

In conclusion, while some celebrities can inspire positive change, young people should be encouraged to choose role models based on values and actions rather than fame.

t2.sampleA2:

t2.sampleB1:
Hi,
I think celebrities are sometimes role models. Some are good, like the sports people who help people. They are good because they do good things. However, some celebrities are not good role models because they do bad things, like drink too much or say bad things. In my opinion, young people should choose their own role models. They should look at what people do, not just if they are famous. For example, my teacher is a good role model. She is kind and helps everyone. So, celebrities can be good, but not always. Thank you.
t2.sampleB2:
Great topic — this is something I've often wondered about myself, so I'm keen to hear what everyone thinks.

Personally, I don't think we should put celebrities on a pedestal. Let's be honest: fame doesn't make someone a good person. Plenty of famous singers and actors are constantly in the spotlight for the wrong reasons, whether it's reckless behaviour or picking fights online. Young fans tend to soak up whatever their idols do, so a bad example can really rub off on them.

That said, I don't want to tar everyone with the same brush. Some celebrities genuinely use their platform for good. Take footballers who campaign against child poverty, or actors who speak up for the environment — they show young people that you can make a difference.

At the end of the day, I reckon it comes down to values, not fame. We should encourage teenagers to look up to people who actually earn their respect, whether that's a famous athlete or a hard-working teacher next door.

What do you all think? Are there any celebrities you'd happily call a role model?

Mashhurlar yoshlar uchun namuna bo'lishi kerakmi, degan savol bugungi kunda jamiyatda juda ko'p bahs-munozaralarga sabab bo'lmoqda.

Ko'pchilik mashhurlar namuna sifatida ko'rilmasligi kerak, deb hisoblaydi. Ularning hayoti ko'pincha norealistik, hashamat va imtiyozlarga to'la bo'lib, oddiy odamlar bunga erisha olmaydi. Bundan tashqari, ba'zi mashhurlar mas'uliyatsiz xatti-harakatlar, giyohvand moddalarni iste'mol qilish yoki ta'sirchan yosh muxlislarga salbiy ta'sir ko'rsatishi mumkin bo'lgan nosog'lom turmush tarzini targ'ib qilish bilan shug'ullanadi.

Biroq, boshqalar ba'zi mashhurlar ijobiy namuna bo'la olishiga ishonadi. Markus Rashford kabi sportchilar o'z platformasidan bolalar qashshoqligiga qarshi kurashish uchun foydalangan, Emma Watson kabi aktyorlar esa gender tengligini himoya qiladi. Bu mashhurlar yoshlarni ijtimoiy masalalarga befarq bo'lmaslikka va o'zgarishlar qilishga ilhomlantiradi.

Mening fikrimcha, mashhurlar avtomatik ravishda namuna deb hisoblanmasligi kerak. Buning o'rniga, yoshlar mashhur bo'ladimi yoki yo'qmi, chinakam ijobiy fazilatlarni namoyon etuvchilarga havas qilishlari kerak. Ota-onalar, o'qituvchilar va jamiyat yetakchilari ko'pincha uzoqdagi mashhurlarga qaraganda yaxshiroq namuna bo'la oladi.

Xulosa qilib aytganda, ba'zi mashhurlar ijobiy o'zgarishlarga ilhomlantirishi mumkin bo'lsa-da, yoshlar mashhurlikka emas, balki qadriyatlar va harakatlarga asoslangan holda namunalarni tanlashga undalishi kerak.

Mening fikrimcha, yoshlar o'zlarining o'rnaklarini o'zlari tanlashlari kerak. Ular odamlarning nima qilayotganiga qarashlari kerak, faqat ular mashhurmi yoki yo'qmi emas. Misol uchun, mening o'qituvchim yaxshi o'rnak. U mehribon va hamma odamga yordam beradi. Shunday qilib, mashhurlar yaxshi bo'lishi mumkin, lekin har doim ham emas. Rahmat.

Mashhurlar yoshlar uchun namuna bo'lishi kerakmi, degan savol murakkab masala. Bir tomondan, ko'plab mashhurlar iste'dod va qattiq mehnat orqali shuhrat va boylikka erishadilar, bu yoshlarni ilhomlantirishi mumkin. Misol uchun, muvaffaqiyatli musiqachilar ko'pincha fidoyilik va qat'iyatlilikni namoyish etadilar. Shuningdek, ba'zi mashhurlar o'z ta'siridan muhim maqsadlarni, masalan, atrof-muhitni muhofaza qilish yoki inson huquqlarini himoya qilishni targ'ib qilish uchun foydalanadilar. Bu xabardorlikni oshirishi va yoshlarni jalb qilishga undashi mumkin.

Biroq, potentsial kamchiliklarni ham tan olish muhim. Mashhurlar ko'pincha kuchli bosim va nazorat ostida bo'ladilar, bu esa nosog'lom xatti-harakatlar va turmush tarziga olib kelishi mumkin. Ularning hayoti ko'pincha ko'pchilik yoshlarning hayotidan uzoqda bo'lib, ularni noreal namunalarga aylantiradi. Bundan tashqari, ba'zi mashhurlar haqiqiy qadriyatlardan ko'ra imij va mashhurlikka ustunlik berishadi. Shuning uchun, mashhurlar ilhom va ijobiy misollar keltirishi mumkin bo'lsa-da, yoshlar ularni namuna deb hisoblashdan oldin ularning harakatlari va qadriyatlarini tanqidiy baholashlari kerak. O'z jamoalarida namuna izlash foydaliroqdir.

t12.title: formal letter · to recipient
t12.prompt: Write a letter to the bicycle rental service. Write about your feelings and what you think they should do.
t12.sample: Dear CityBike Customer Team, Thank you for your email requesting feedback on my recent experience with your bicycle rental service. Overall, I found the service convenient and affordable. The app was easy to download and use for locating nearby docking stations. The bicycles I used were in good condition with properly working brakes and gears. However, I encountered some issues that could be improved. On two occasions, the nearest docking stations were completely full, forcing me to cycle further to return the bike. I would suggest expanding the number of docking stations in popular areas. Additionally, some bikes had uncomfortable seats that could be upgraded. I would also appreciate having helmets available for rent at the stations for safety reasons. Despite these minor issues, I will continue using your service. Yours sincerely, Nodirbek Salimov

Hi CityBike,


Bike is good. App is okay. More bikes, please. Bye.
t12.sampleA2:
Hi CityBike,


Thank you for the bikes. The bike was good, and the app was easy. But sometimes no bikes! I want more bikes near my house because it is difficult. Also, the seats are not very good. Thank you.


Bye,


Nodirbek Salimov
t12.sampleB1:
Dear CityBike Customer Team,


Thank you for asking about my experience with CityBike. I think it's a good service. The app was easy to use, and I liked that I could find bikes easily. The bikes were mostly okay, but one bike had a problem with the brakes.


However, I think you should have more docking stations. I couldn't find a free space to return the bike once, and it was annoying. Also, maybe you could check the bikes more often to make sure they are working properly. I would use the service more if these things were better.


Thanks,


Nodirbek Salimov
t12.sampleB2:
Dear CityBike Customer Team,

Thank you for reaching out for feedback on my recent experience with your bicycle rental service.

On the whole, I was pleasantly surprised. The app was straightforward to use, and I had no trouble locating a bike or a docking station near me. The bicycle itself was in good condition, and cycling proved to be a convenient way to get around the city centre.

That said, there is certainly room for improvement. On a couple of occasions, the nearest station was completely full, which meant I had to cycle much further to return the bike. I would strongly suggest adding more docking stations in busy areas. It would also be worth offering helmets for hire, as this would put safety first.

Overall, I was impressed and will happily use CityBike again.

Yours sincerely,
Nodirbek Salimov

Men foydalangan velosiped umuman yaxshi saqlangan edi, garchi shinalar biroz kam shishirilgandek tuyuldi. Kichik noqulaylik eng yuqori soatlarda docking stantsiyalarining cheklanganligi bo'lib, muqobil joyga burilishni talab qildi.


Xizmatni yanada yaxshilash uchun men velosipedlarga texnik xizmat ko'rsatish chastotasini oshirishni va aholi zich joylashgan hududlarda docking stantsiyalari tarmog'ini kengaytirishni taklif qilaman. Bundan tashqari, tez-tez foydalanuvchilar uchun chegirma taklif qilish ko'proq sayohat qilishga undashi mumkin. Menimcha, bu yaxshilanishlar umumiy foydalanuvchi tajribasiga sezilarli hissa qo'shadi.


Hurmat bilan,


Nodirbek Salimov
